encoding.provenance: specified: the encoder aider uses for its own counts, see count_tokens in .claude/skills/aider-setup/scripts/aider-rules-sync.py

chars_per_token.provenance: specified: context_budget.CHARS_PER_TOKEN, the planning-time rule of thumb of this repository for English prose

estimate_margin.provenance: measured 2026-10-17 by the session on the twelve files of the local coding contract round: real tokens over estimated tokens ranged 0.99 to 1.20, so 1.25 covers the worst file seen

binary_probe_bytes.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17 by the session: a NUL byte in the first 8192 bytes marks a file as binary, as git and grep do on a similar window

max_file_bytes.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17 by the session: above 5 MB a source is named and skipped rather than read, far above any plan, spec or code file this repository holds

encoder_load_timeout_s.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17 by the session (R10): loading an encoder may download its file, and this runs inside a PreToolUse hook with a 30 second deadline, so a stalled download degrades to the estimate after ten seconds

skip_dir_names.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17 by the session: directories never holding a counted source when a folder is walked
